notes: This is a new six-horizon experiment:3,6,12,24,36,48h. Never resume the older four-horizon or GWN checkpoints.

Recommended training: LR0.001, curriculum decay200, ReduceLROnPlateau factor0.5 patience3 minLR1e-5; early stopping10 maxepochs50.
Adam epsilon0.001, weight_decay0, dropout0, raw-unitMAE and48h encoder history are retained.
Primary checkpoint selection remains validation6h RMSE. A separate24h selection config is provided; all six arms must share the chosen config.
All arms keep635nodes and the same train2021-22 directed graph; PM observation masks and allowed trajectory context change only.
Target labels36/48 are exact observed Junggu values at origin+h, never imputed; crossing split/study bounds is ineligible.
Old3/6/12/24 labels, eligibility and audited baselines are preserved exactly. New36/48 seasonal baseline uses t-12h/t, never future observations.
Common score filenames and column schemas are preserved in Model/Common/DCRNN_H48_20261111; old common files are not edited.
With seed11 and all sixarms, baseline42+input7contrasts*6=84tests are corrected together. This family differs from earlier four-horizon runs.
Single seed11 does not establish training robustness. Test2024 has already been inspected in this project.
Full inference/scoring and verifiedDrivebackup follow each arm; every invocation uses a new result directory.
Default safe scope remains retrospective data availability; real reporting latency has not been reproduced.
